items.label: Who and which coupon
items.message: NOM-PLT-L1, plate; a new coupon: its folder and case page are written when it runs

items.label: Units consistent
items.message: every row in mm, MPa and N; the model is written in mm-MPa and forces come out in N

items.label: Material defined
items.message: Nominal-Alloy: the team's own constants: nominal isotropic values of the validation case plate-ss-isotropic-uniform-pressure-navier, not a cited material; rights class user-supplied; no strengths, so no failure criterion can be reported

items.label: Laminate assigned
items.message: 1 plies [0], 1 mm thick; symmetric; the flat shell kernel solves it

items.label: Constraints defined
items.message: Edge-Left (17 nodes) holds z, the tilt about x; Edge-Right (17 nodes) holds z, the tilt about x; Edge-Bottom (17 nodes) holds z, the tilt about y; Edge-Top (17 nodes) holds z, the tilt about y; Corner-Origin (1 nodes) holds x, y; Corner-X (1 nodes) holds y; no rigid-body motion is left

items.label: Load applied
items.message: a pressure of -0.01 MPa on Face along the normal (pushing toward +z)

items.label: Mesh quality acceptable
items.message: 256 elements, 289 nodes (structured mesh, order 1); aspect ratio 1 at worst (warns above 10); smallest angle 90° at worst (warns below 10°); largest angle 90° at worst (warns above 160°); Jacobian ratio 1 at worst (warns below 0.1)

items.label: Failure criterion
items.message: no failure criterion: first-ply failure will not be reported (the material has no strengths)

items.label: Result points inside the coupon
items.message: results are read at node centre at (50, 50), element centre (mm)

items.label: Reference solver installed
items.message: CalculiX 2.22 at C:\Tools\PrePoMax v2.6.0\Solver\ccx_dynamic.exe: the reference solver that checks our engine's result

items.label: Document builder installed
items.message: Tectonic at C:\Users\erikv\AppData\Local\Programs\tectonic\tectonic.EXE: the package gets its PDF
